summary.text: Elena Parent, a Democrat, was elected to the Georgia State Senate in 2014 and represents Senate District 44, covering parts of DeKalb and Clayton counties.

paragraphs.text: Parent previously served in the Georgia House of Representatives, sworn in in January 2011.
Parent began her career as a litigation attorney after earning undergraduate and law degrees at the University of Virginia, and chairs the Senate Democratic Caucus.
